scenarios.label: Managed Interdependence
scenarios.words: No supplier is removed. Where a supply-chain step is more concentrated than comparable goods, no supplier may hold more than the share that would bring it to that benchmark; trade and new capacity replace the excess.

scenarios.label: Decoupling
scenarios.words: Zembla stops supplying the allied market (it keeps buying); trade and new capacity replace what it supplied.

countries.narrative: Avalon: Combines demand & market and capital & investment roles; secondary coordination / bridge role. First among allied economies in share of allied demand. Contributes: Magnets, magnet parts & assemblies (18%); strongest in component nodes. Needs: Rare-earth oxides & compounds (41% of allied demand), Synthetic graphite (anode-grade, spherical) (38% of allied demand); a significant net buyer of raw and processed materials (top quartile of allied net imports). Main compacts: Permanent Magnets & Drive Systems (demand anchor: magnets), Battery Materials & Cells (demand anchor: anode materials). Highest-value partners (Managed Interdependence network): Carpania, Borduria, Elbonia.
